title: A Primer of the Counterweight Beam
summary: Teaches an unawakened beginner the parts of a counterweight trebuchet and the plain crew work of cranking loading and release.

title: Handbook of the Haul-Rope Team
summary: Drills a team of beginners to haul a traction trebuchet beam down together and let go of the rope on a single call.

title: Drill-Book for Carrying Dressed Shot
summary: Builds the lifting and carrying strength a crewman needs to bring dressed stone shot safely from the stack to the sling.

title: A Plain Treatise on Pin and Trip
summary: Sets out the care of the release pin and trip line so a body-only crewman can loose the engine cleanly.

title: Workbook of the Frame and Sill
summary: Teaches crewmen to level the sill and set the uprights true so the trebuchet is sound before its first shot.

title: Handbook of the Trial Shot
summary: Teaches a first-year cultivator to range a trebuchet by trial shots with a little circulating qi steadying the arms.

title: A Primer of the Sling and Its Length
summary: Shows a young cultivator how to plait match and trim a sling and how its length changes the flight of the shot.

title: Canon of the Steady Windlass
summary: Teaches the steady turning of the windlass and the pawl so a long winding never lets the beam run back.

title: Drill-Book of the Crew's Calls
summary: Drills the stations calls and signals that let a crew of cultivators load wind and loose the engine as one body.

title: A Treatise on Safe Ground for the Swinging Arm
summary: Teaches a young cultivator how to keep the engine yard clear and to survive a slipped shot or a parting cable.
